theorems.name: parse_color_total
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** Parsing a colour never panics, for any bytes.
theorems.statement: theorem parse_color_total (s : Slice Std.U8) : ∃ r, parse_color s = ok r
theorems.proof:
theorem parse_color_total (s : Slice Std.U8) : ∃ r, parse_color s = ok r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (parse_color_spec s)
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

theorems.name: parse_color_shape
theorems.doc: **S.** An accepted colour is 7 bytes with an ASCII first byte.
theorems.statement:
theorem parse_color_shape (s : Slice Std.U8) (c : Rgb)
    (h : parse_color s = ok (some c)) : s.val.length = 7 ∧ (s.val[0]!).val < 128
theorems.proof:
theorem parse_color_shape (s : Slice Std.U8) (c : Rgb)
    (h : parse_color s = ok (some c)) : s.val.length = 7 ∧ (s.val[0]!).val < 128 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (parse_color_spec s)
  rw [hr] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  exact hp c h

theorems.name: hex_value_digit
theorems.statement: theorem hex_value_digit (b : Std.U8) : ∃ v, hex_value b = ok v ∧ v.val ≤ 16
theorems.proof:
theorem hex_value_digit (b : Std.U8) : ∃ v, hex_value b = ok v ∧ v.val ≤ 16 := by
  exact (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (hex_value_spec b)

byte_at.lean:
def byte_at (s : Slice Std.U8) (i : Std.Usize) : Result (Option Std.U8) := do
  let i1 ← Slice.index_usize s i
  let hi ← hex_value i1
  let i2 ← i + 1#usize
  let i3 ← Slice.index_usize s i2
  let lo ← hex_value i3
  if hi > 15#u8
  then ok none
  else
    if lo > 15#u8
    then ok none
    else let i4 ← hi * 16#u8
         let i5 ← i4 + lo
         ok (some i5)
byte_at.upstream_note: one byte (two hex digits) of hex::decode_to_slice into the RGB8

parse_color.lean:
def parse_color (s : Slice Std.U8) : Result (Option Rgb) := do
  let i := Slice.len s
  if i != 7#usize
  then ok none
  else
    let i1 ← Slice.index_usize s 0#usize
    if i1 >= 128#u8
    then ok none
    else
      let o ← byte_at s 1#usize
      match o with
      | none => ok none
      | some v =>
        let o1 ← byte_at s 3#usize
        match o1 with
        | none => ok none
        | some v1 =>
          let o2 ← byte_at s 5#usize
          match o2 with
          | none => ok none
          | some v2 => ok (some { r := v, g := v1, b := v2 })
parse_color.upstream_note: set_color's &data.color[1..] + decode_to_slice(..).unwrap(); the port returns None exactly where upstream panics (U1)

def hex_value (b : Std.U8) : Result Std.U8 := do
  if b >= 48#u8
  then
    if b <= 57#u8
    then b - 48#u8
    else
      if b >= 97#u8
      then
        if b <= 102#u8
        then b - 87#u8
        else
          if b >= 65#u8
          then if b <= 70#u8
               then b - 55#u8
               else ok 16#u8
          else ok 16#u8
      else
        if b >= 65#u8
        then if b <= 70#u8
             then b - 55#u8
             else ok 16#u8
        else ok 16#u8
  else
    if b >= 97#u8
    then
      if b <= 102#u8
      then b - 87#u8
      else
        if b >= 65#u8
        then if b <= 70#u8

        else ok 16#u8

      if b >= 65#u8
      then if b <= 70#u8
           then b - 55#u8
           else ok 16#u8
      else ok 16#u8
